name: Mio Kamishiro
description: Class President of Class 2-B and Literature Club President; excellent grades, diligent work ethic, habitually hides anxiety beneath politeness and orderliness.

fields.favoriteTopic: Books, School Festival publications, quiet places
fields.availability: In Class 2-B before morning reading and during breaks; in the Literature Club Activity Room after school; occasionally in the Library during lunch breaks for proofreading
fields.currentConcern: Completing the table of contents for 'Spring Mint' and justifying the club's continued existence before the budget preliminary review at 14 days countdown

name: Rin Asakura
description: News Club Reporter, quick to act, casually flippant in speech, skilled at using jokes to probe people's true reactions.

fields.availability: Between classes and during lunch at Class 2-B or the Courtyard Notice Board; after school in the News Club editing room
fields.currentConcern: Deciding how to report on the Transfer Student and drawing boundaries between interviewing and friendship for the 'Rumor Truth Wall'

name: Kaho Shiina
description: Guitarist in the Light Music Club, an intuitive doer who seems carefree but is actually very serious about the stage and the people she likes.

fields.favoriteTopic: Music, the way home from school, the stage
fields.availability: May pass through the Courtyard with her guitar during lunch; in the Light Music Club Practice Room after school; occasionally goes to the Sakurazaka Seawall at dusk
fields.currentConcern: Finish the last part of her new song before the main stage rehearsal seven days away, and overcome the shadow of last year's mistake

name: Yuma Shiraishi
description: Vice President of the Student Council, calm and rule-abiding, responsible for club registration and School Festival procedures, often misunderstood as lacking Social Obligation.

fields.availability: In the Student Council Room during breaks; reviews club materials after school; patrols the Club Building and rooftop at 17:40
fields.currentConcern: Complete the preliminary budget review according to procedure while preserving space for genuinely hardworking clubs to appeal or submit additional documents

name: Haruka Mikoeda
description: President of the Student Council, third year. Gentle and precise, she has a habit of using one sentence to bring disputes back to procedure; she makes the final call on resource allocation for the School Festival.

fields.availability: In the Student Council Room after lunch or after school; inspects the Courtyard, Club Building, and main stage during key Milestones
fields.currentConcern: Completing her last School Festival and handing off the Student Council without letting so-called fairness erase the efforts of small Clubs

name: Chihiro Onodera
description: Homeroom Teacher of Class 2-B, Japanese Language teacher, and former Advisor of the Literature Club. He respects student autonomy and gives gentle reminders, but rarely solves problems for students directly.

fields.club: Staff · Former Advisor of the Literature Club
fields.favoriteTopic: Old books, students' own choices, not rushing to give answers
fields.availability: Class hours and morning reading in Class 2-B. Stays briefly in the classroom after duty shifts. Passes by the Old Journal Shelf in the Library when needed.
fields.currentConcern: Helping the Transfer Student adapt to the Class without solving their problems for them, and ensuring the Literature Club gets a chance to fight for itself.

name: Souta Morikawa
description: Light Music Club drummer, Kaho's teammate, Class 2-A. Outgoing and quick-tongued, he often mistakes others' silence for agreement; capable of creating comedic misunderstandings, but also reminds the player of Kaho's pressure in the stage storyline.

fields.favoriteTopic: Bands, live performances, turning serious matters into jokes
fields.availability: Lunch break may be spent in Class 2-A or the Courtyard; fixed at the Light Music Club Practice Room after school; visits Hoshisuna Instrument Shop before rehearsals
fields.currentConcern: Checking main stage equipment and looking for an opportunity to confess his oversight responsibility for last year's malfunction

name: Akane Toujou
description: A third-year Head Librarian, a quiet senior girl, and a regular at Umineko Bookstore. Having witnessed clubs disappear and people desperately trying to preserve something, she deeply understands the value of quiet companionship.

fields.favoriteTopic: Books, old School Festival special issues, dusk at the seawall
fields.availability: In the Library during lunch breaks and after school until 5:30 PM; occasionally goes to Umineko Bookstore or Sakurazaka Seawall after closing
fields.currentConcern: Organizing signed pages from old publications before graduation, and determining if her sister's past preservation campaign can still help the Literature Club today
